spec.title: HashiStack / Consul
spec.description: Consul servers and agents: autopilot/raft, RPC and rate limiting, catalog size, KV and ACL latency, agent and Connect CA certificate runway, xDS streams to the Envoy sidecars.

spec.title: Leaders
spec.description: Servers that believe they are leader. Must be exactly 1.

spec.title: Autopilot unhealthy
spec.description: Alert ConsulAutopilotUnhealthy after 5m.

spec.title: Failure tolerance
spec.description: Servers that can fail without losing quorum.

spec.title: Servers / clients
spec.description: LAN members (servers + clients) known to the cluster.

spec.title: Services
spec.description: Registered services in the catalog.

spec.title: Service instances
spec.description: Service instances in the catalog.

spec.title: Connect instances
spec.description: Mesh (Connect) instances.

spec.title: KV entries
spec.description: Keys in the KV store.

spec.title: Sidecars off xDS
spec.description: Envoy sidecars not connected to their Consul agent's xDS server: they keep serving their last config but miss intention, upstream and certificate updates. (Read from Envoy: consul_xds_server_streams reports 0 on these agents.)

spec.title: Agent cert runway
spec.description: Soonest Consul agent TLS certificate expiry (alert below 4h).

spec.title: Connect root CA
spec.description: Runway of the active Connect root CA (alert below 30d).

spec.title: Connect signing CA
spec.description: Runway of the Vault-backed intermediate that signs mesh leaves.

spec.title: Raft commit time p99
spec.description: Time to commit a log entry to quorum.

spec.title: Raft applies
spec.description: Raft transactions per second.

spec.title: Server RPC
spec.description: RPCs reaching the servers, errors and requests refused by the rate limiter.

spec.title: Blocking queries
spec.description: Long-poll queries held open on each server (Nomad, vault-agent and consul-template watches).

spec.title: Agent → server RPC failures
spec.description: Client agents failing or being throttled talking to the servers.

spec.title: Agent HTTP API p99 (top 10 paths)
spec.description: Slowest local-agent HTTP endpoints. Blocking catalog/health calls are long by design.

spec.title: KV / txn apply p99
spec.description: Write latency of KV and transaction endpoints on the leader. Gaps = no writes in the interval.

spec.title: Catalog writes
spec.description: Service registration churn. Spikes follow deploys or flapping allocations.

spec.title: ACL resolve p99
spec.description: Time to resolve an ACL token, per agent.

spec.title: ACL token cache miss ratio
spec.description: Share of token lookups that missed the agent cache and went to the servers.

spec.title: Agent TLS cert runway
spec.description: Seconds until each agent's certificate expires.

spec.title: xDS-connected sidecars per node
spec.description: Envoys connected to the local agent's xDS server, per node. A node dropping to zero means its agent stopped serving config.

spec.title: gRPC streams / connections
spec.description: gRPC (xDS, agentless and peering) streams and connections held by the servers.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Goroutines per agent; servers run more.

spec.title: Heap allocated
spec.description: Go heap in use per agent.

spec.title: Memberlist gossip p99
spec.description: Gossip round time; high values precede flapping members.
